newsitem.title: USA: Figgie to divest Taylor Environmental.
newsitem.headline: Figgie to divest Taylor Environmental.

text.p: Figgie International Inc said Wednesday it had decided to divest its Taylor Environmental unit.
Figgie said it would focus on its three core businesses -- Snorkel, Scott Aviation and Interstate Electroncs.

With the assistance of Morgan Stanley & Co Inc and Smith Barney Inc, Figgie said it would use proceeds from the sale of Taylor Environmental for general corporate purposes, including reducing corporate overhead.
Taylor Environmental has annual revenues of $18 million, it said.

On July 17 Figgie said it would pursue the sale of one or more of its business units. It said the sale of the entire company had been determined by the board not to be an acceptable strategic alternative for delivering enhanced value to shareholders.
